cohort: 7,484 women who underwent cesarean section at a hospital in the Central Vindhya region of India over a 3-year period.
finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 28.18%, with multiparous women with prior cesarean sections (Robson's group 5) accounting for the largest proportion of cesarean sections (32.58%).
gest_age: Not specified, but Robson's classification includes gestational age as a factor.
